tweet.text:
@YafahEdelman I think an underrated source of leverage for METR is, ironically, how limited the ecosystem is? 

Like if METR harshly criticizes a lab for something and they want to switch to another third party, there are few options which aren't very obviously a huge downgrade in expertise.
